correctness.rationale: The finite chain is irreducible for every a>0. Generator action on the marked complex product yields the exact second-order recurrence, whose Dirichlet boundary values are C0=Cn=1. Solving using cosh(kappa)=1+a gives the formula for all n>=3,q>=3,a>0. The joint limit follows from n*kappa->sqrt(2c) and omega^-n depending only on n mod q. Independent sparse finite-state generator reconstructions passed all separations for five q>=3 systems and scaling checks; tests do not replace the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The signed complex two-point observable measures propagation of cyclic phase coherence in a natural driven multicolour copying process. The exact all-size solution exposes a sharp n^-2 noise-versus-cycle winding scale and q distinct topological residue profiles. The zero-refresh interior coherence is exactly 1 if q divides n and strictly below 1 otherwise. This separates coherent phase winding from frustration without a Gibbs assumption; it is not an arbitrary fixed finite table or a mere rewrite of a two-colour Ising correlation.
